definition: Ayotle is a French-Mexican company headquartered in Paris, France, that develops computer vision software.
details: It provides technical services based on motion capture and 3D sensors for interactive applications in the media and entertainment industries. The company was co-founded by José Alonso Ybanez Zepeda and Gisèle Belliot in June 2010. Ayotle is mainly focused on the development and implementation of advanced algorithms for computer vision, from video images in all formats to the use of 3D cameras or depth sensors.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Ayotle — giving a machine the gift of sight.
